en: A black and white image depicting a large, historic castle-like building with two prominent Gothic cathedral spires dominating the hilltop. Below it flows a wide river, upon which a steam-powered paddle boat travels. In the foreground are several trees and riverside structures. On the hill, one can discern classic European architecture with steep roofs. Some signage is visible, but is difficult to read in detail.
